scope: All inventoried chart graph types/members including inherited and underscore-prefixed interfaces; data builders have their own ledger.

mappings.constructors: Owner-returned graph interfaces use explicit read/write capabilities over validated XmlPart; no ambient file, process, network or native runtime.
mappings.bytes: bounded XmlElementView over owned subtree; removal invalidates held handles
mappings.collections: checked at/numeric lookup, length, iteration, reversed, includes/count/index; Plots.slice shares sequenceSlice; point indexes reject negatives
mappings.text: Chart txPr and rich bind shared TextFrame/Font, no duplicate text engine
mappings.drawing: ChartFormat binds shared FillFormat/LineFormat/ShadowFormat. apply(DrawingUpdate) is an explicit added format-package command primitive.
mappings.replacement: replace_data normalizes builders through toChartData, uses explicit package owner callback; detached graph throws PropertyAccessError
mappings.category: Category string-subclass behavior maps to immutable label/idx values, toString and equals; chart namespace distinguishes graph Category from builder data Category
